_note: Constitutional standards, national planning trajectories and best-practice operational benchmarks used by the model. Every entry carries a source. Per-TFC overrides live in baseline.json.

rtt.standard: 92% of incomplete pathways waiting under 18 weeks
rtt.source: NHS Constitution; user-specified NUH trajectory (65% Apr-27, 80% Apr-28, 92% Apr-29); national ambition 92% by March 2029 per Elective Reform Plan

fds.standard: Faster Diagnosis Standard: diagnosis or ruling-out within 28 days

day31.standard: 31 days from decision-to-treat to first/subsequent treatment

day62.standard: 62 days from urgent referral to first treatment
day62.source: NHSE cancer waiting times standards; 2025/26 planning guidance

diagnostics.standard: DM01: max 6 weeks from referral to test
diagnostics.note: Constitutional expectation <1% waiting 6+ weeks; interim planning ambition 95% under 6 weeks by March 2026

fourHour.note: 78% national 2025/26 ambition; 82% objective in Medium Term Planning Framework 2026/27-2028/29
fourHour.source: NHS Constitution; NHSE Medium Term Planning Framework

handover.standard: Ambulance handover within 15 minutes; none over 60 minutes
handover.note: NUH operates a 45-minute maximum handover process (from Dec 2024)
handover.source: NHSE UEC recovery plan; NUH board reporting

theatreUtilisation.source: GIRFT/NHSE: providers targeted to achieve minimum 85% capped theatre utilisation

dayCaseRate.unit: share of eligible elective surgery as day case
dayCaseRate.note: BADS/GIRFT: overall day-case rates range 60-85%; BADS directory sets procedure-level targets — per-TFC overrides used
dayCaseRate.source: British Association of Day Surgery directory; GIRFT day-case delivery guides

outpatientDNA.source: NHS Elect outpatient transformation benchmarks; GIRFT outpatients

newToFollowUpRatio.note: GIRFT outpatients: reduce follow-ups via PIFU; specialty-specific overrides apply

pifuShare.unit: share of outpatient contacts moved to patient-initiated follow-up

bedOccupancy.unit: target max general & acute bed occupancy
bedOccupancy.source: NHSE planning guidance (92% G&A occupancy ambition)

elective LOS.source: GIRFT specialty reports / Model Health System
